## History

Carrie Sloane was a young girl whose father, like [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), disapproved of small girls attending night concerts. Despite her father's strict views, she was allowed to go to a party at [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) Barry's house, where the children played a game of dares.
